q: Which locator does Playwright recommend first for finding a button?
explain: `getByRole` matches how users and assistive tech see the page, so it is the most resilient. CSS and XPath are the last resort.

q: A locator can go stale like an ElementHandle.
explain: Locators re-query the DOM every time they are used and auto-wait, so they do not go stale.
